scripts.title: anticheat bypahher
scripts.script:
local a = game:GetService("RunService")
local b = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local c = workspace:WaitForChild("Players"):WaitForChild("FFA"):WaitForChild(b.Name)
local d = {}
local e
e = hookmetamethod(game, "__newindex", function(f, g, h)
    if g == "Parent" and h then
        if (f:IsA("LocalScript") or f:IsA("Script")) and h:IsDescendantOf(c) then
            local i = f.Name:lower()
            if i:match("anticheat") or i:match("anti%-cheat") or i:match("anti_cheat") then
                return
            end
        end
    end
    return e(f, g, h)
end)
for _, j in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
    d[j] = true
end
a.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local k = {}
    for _, j in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
        k[j] = true
        if not d[j] then
            d[j] = true
            if j:IsA("Script") or j:IsA("LocalScript") then
                local i = j.Name:lower()
                if i:match("anticheat") or i:match("anti%-cheat") or i:match("anti_cheat") then
                    j:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for j in pairs(d) do
        if not k[j] then
            d[j] = nil
        end
    end
end)
scripts.features: anticheat bypass (run before you press play)
